display.purpose: Hero lockup and overlay index labels.

motion.name: ease-exit
motion.purpose: Column lean, overlay wipe, cue reveal.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid bone CTA. Inverts to outline on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #f4f4f1; background: #f4f4f1; color: #050505; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: transparent; color: #f4f4f1; outline: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outline bone CTA. Fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #f4f4f1; background: transparent; color: #f4f4f1; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: #f4f4f1; color: #050505; outline: none; }

components.name: Spine Field
components.description: Uppercase mono field; inverts on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #f4f4f1; background: transparent; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f4f4f1; outline: none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: rgba(244, 244, 241, 0.4); } .ds-field:focus { background: #f4f4f1; color: #050505; } .ds-field:focus::placeholder { color: rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.45); }

components.name: Column Nav
components.description: Italic outlined labels; fill when current.
components.css: .ds-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.65rem; } .ds-col-link { color: rgba(244, 244, 241, 0.18); -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(244, 244, 241, 0.62); font-family: Oswald, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.85; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-col-link.is-active, .ds-col-link:hover, .ds-col-link:focus-visible { color: #f4f4f1; -webkit-text-stroke-color: transparent; outline: none; }

components.name: Inline Tag
components.description: Sharp mono capsule used in the hero (WEB / SEO / STRATEGY).
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72em; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.2em 0.45em; border: 1px solid #f4f4f1; color: #f4f4f1; }

narrative.overview: You enter at the skull and drop through a xeroxed column. Type is vertebrae, grain is bone dust, black is the canal. Oswald italic display versus IBM Plex Mono instrumentation. No second accent.
keyCharacteristics: Skull at the top, column below
Oswald italic vs IBM Plex Mono

rules.name: The One Bone Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second accent.

rules.name: The Stroke Fill Rule
rules.body: Idle nav is outlined; active and hover fill bone.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: UI chrome is flat; only the specimen occupies space.

dos: Do keep display italic, uppercase, tight tracking.
Do invert bone and void for hover and focus.
Do treat nav as a column/spine.
donts: Don't add colored accents or rounded pills.
Don't put a sticky multi-link header over the descent.
